title: China Begins Mass Production of Homegrown DUV Chip Tools - Slashdot

content_html:
According to The Information (paywalled), a state-backed Shanghai company has begun mass-producing China's first homegrown immersion DUV lithography machines, with about five units expected this year for SMIC, Hua Hong, and CXMT. Roughly 20 more units are expected in 2027. Tom's Hardware reports: The Information didn't name the manufacturer, but its sources described the operation as having pulled DUV development teams from several Chinese companies, one of them the state-backed startup Shanghai Yuliangsheng Technology. SMIC has been testing a Yuliangsheng immersion tool since September 2025. Most components in the new systems are domestic, though some critical parts still come from Japan, and delays at local suppliers have held back output this year.

[...] China accounts for around 20% of ASML's net sales this year, down from 33% in 2025, driven mainly by mainstream logic demand... Independent analysis from the AI Futures Project in June put commercial-scale Chinese immersion DUV in the mid-2030s, with ASML holding 98.7% of the immersion market. Qualifying the new machines for production lines could take many months, and they trail ASML's tools on performance and build quality. China's domestic EUV effort, which Reuters first reported as a working prototype in December, remains years away.

sentences.zh: 据The Information（付费专区）报道，上海一家有政府背景的公司已开始批量生产中国第一台国产浸没式 DUV 光刻机，预计今年将为中芯国际、华虹和长鑫存储生产约 5 台。

sentences.en: Roughly 20 more units are expected in 2027.
sentences.zh: 预计 2027 年将新增约 20 个单位。

sentences.en: Tom's Hardware reports: The Information didn't name the manufacturer, but its sources described the operation as having pulled DUV development teams from several Chinese companies, one of them the state-backed startup Shanghai Yuliangsheng Technology.
sentences.zh: Tom's Hardware 报道：《The Information》没有透露制造商的名字，但消息人士称，此次行动从几家中国公司撤走了 DUV 开发团队，其中之一是国有初创公司上海宇良盛科技。

sentences.en: SMIC has been testing a Yuliangsheng immersion tool since September 2025.
sentences.zh: 中芯国际自 2025 年 9 月以来一直在测试 Yuliangsheng 沉浸式工具。

sentences.en: Most components in the new systems are domestic, though some critical parts still come from Japan, and delays at local suppliers have held back output this year. [...]
sentences.zh: 新系统中的大多数部件都是国产的，但一些关键部件仍然来自日本，而且当地供应商的延误导致今年的产量受到抑制。 [...]

sentences.en: China accounts for around 20% of ASML's net sales this year, down from 33% in 2025, driven mainly by mainstream logic demand...
sentences.zh: 中国今年占 ASML 净销售额的 20% 左右，低于 2025 年的 33%，主要由主流逻辑需求推动……

sentences.en: Independent analysis from the AI Futures Project in June put commercial-scale Chinese immersion DUV in the mid-2030s, with ASML holding 98.7% of the immersion market.
sentences.zh: AI Futures Project 6 月份的独立分析认为，中国沉浸式 DUV 商业规模将于 2030 年代中期实现，其中 ASML 占据沉浸式市场 98.7% 的份额。

sentences.en: Qualifying the new machines for production lines could take many months, and they trail ASML's tools on performance and build quality.
sentences.zh: 新机器的生产线资格认证可能需要数月时间，而且它们在性能和制造质量方面落后于 ASML 的工具。

sentences.en: China's domestic EUV effort, which Reuters first reported as a working prototype in December, remains years away.
sentences.zh: 路透社去年 12 月首次报道称，中国国内的 EUV 工作仍需数年时间。
